title: DISTINCTCOUNT of a column holding apple, Apple, APPLE, pear is 2

source.quote: The engine that stores and queries data in Power BI is case insensitive, and treats different capitalization of letters as the same value
source.supports: text that differs only in case is the same value, for comparison and for storage

source.quote: The first instance of the string is used as the canonical representation
source.supports: the first occurrence is what later equivalent strings are shown as

derivation: CaseT[Txt] holds apple, Apple, APPLE, pear. The engine is case insensitive, so the three spellings of apple are one value: the distinct values are apple and pear, 2. DISTINCTCOUNT returns an integer.
